name: Salguti Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Salguti Industries Ltd manufactures HDPE/PP Woven sacks for packing of Fertilizers & Cement[1]
keyPoints:
Business Divisions:[1][2] 
a) Plastic Division: SIL is having 2 Plastic units which manufacture HDPE/PP woven sacks to serve the Fertilizers, Sugar, Cement and Food Grain Industries as a supplier in Telengana/ Andhra Pradesh
b) Textiles Division: Company diversified into Textiles Industry by setting up a weaving division and started manufacturing cotton grey fabric for garments, bed linen and furnishings. Company exited the textile business in Q3 FY18

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.50% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.19% over last 3 years.
